ezekiel.31.p1.b1.text: Son of man, say to Pharaoh king of Egypt and to his multitude: Who can be compared to your greatness?

ezekiel.31.p1.b2.text: Look at Assyria, a cedar in Lebanon, with beautiful branches that shaded the forest. It towered on high; its top was among the clouds.

ezekiel.31.p1.b3.text: All the birds of the air nested in its branches … all the great nations lived in its shade.

ezekiel.31.p1.b4.text: Foreigners, the most ruthless of the nations, cut it down and left it. … And all the peoples of the earth left its shade and abandoned it.

ezekiel.31.p1.b5.text: All the birds of the air nested on its fallen trunk

ezekiel.31.p1.b6.text: I made the nations quake at the sound of its downfall, when I cast it down to Sheol

ezekiel.31.p1.b7.text: This is Pharaoh and all his multitude, declares the Lord GOD.
